title: IED plugin manifest v1 (ied-plugin.json)
description: One file per plugin at the plugin root. Field names are frozen once v1 ships; additions must be optional.

id.description: Stable forever. Built-ins use 'ied.<name>'. Language plugins use their language id (e.g. 'c4').

icon.description: Relative path to an SVG used in plugin lists.

api.description: Semver range of the host API, e.g. '^1'.

activation.description: When to load code (declarative contributions are always registered). Empty = on startup.

themeColor.description: A theme token's name ('--hue-blue', docs/07); raw colors are refused.

kind.description: builtin = compiled into ied-server; declarative = manifest only; c4 = C4 code the server compiles with its script host (docs/26 section 2).

sources.description: c4: the folders and files of the plugin's code, in its folder (default ['code']); every .cf file under them is compiled.

ui.description: Path to the browser ES module that registers UI contributions.

icon.description: Codicon name ('$(debug-start)') or relative SVG path.

fileIcons.description: How files look in every file list (docs/15 'Icons'): a short label in a theme hue, or the plugin's own picture.

fileNames.description: Whole names ('CMakeLists.txt'), matched without case; they win over extensions.

label.description: Up to four characters drawn as the icon: 'C++', 'h', 'RS'. The files of a pair get different labels (a header 'h').

icon.description: '$(codicon)' or an SVG path in the plugin's folder, instead of a label.

projectIcons.description: How projects look in the Solution Explorer (docs/15 'Icons'): a thin tile with a short label in a theme hue. A project is matched by its .iedproj 'language', else its presets or build system, else a marker file in its root folder.

markers.description: File names in a project's root folder that say its language ('Cargo.toml'); '*.csproj' matches by extension.

outputLinks.description: The places a language's tools print in plain output, underlined in the Output window and opened on a click (docs/26).

regexp.description: A JavaScript regular expression over one line.

companionTabs.description: Tabs that open beside a document of these languages when it is opened from outside IED (a Markdown file's preview, docs/26).

kind.description: A tab kind a UI module registers; the tab is '<kind>:<path>'.

searchPaths.description: Extra relative folders to look in (e.g. '../include').

follow.description: A counterpart opened to the side, tethered, follows the file its partner's group shows when that is one of these too (docs/15 'Tethered tabs').

fileOpener.description: The command the shell runs with {path, line, col} (1-based) for a file a launch URL names; the last loaded plugin's wins.

fileNesting.description: Parent pattern to child patterns, e.g. {'*.cf': ['${basename}.ch']}.

aiDocs.description: Reference docs the AI searches and reads with docs_search and docs_read: Markdown files under a folder inside the plugin (a language's manual, its library's API).

id.description: The first part of the docs' paths for the AI (c4/library/bedrock.md).

folder.description: Relative to the plugin's folder, inside it.

aiHints.description: Advice the AI sees under a line of a tool's output its regex finds: a compiler error a model makes in this language, and what to write instead.

match.description: A regex searched for in each line of build_run, problems_list, shell_run and program_run results.

items.description: Path to an agent-mode.v1 JSON file.

schema.description: Path to a JSON Schema; each property may carry 'x-ied-tiers': ['app','solution','project'] and 'x-ied-merge'.

profilerImporters.description: A command that turns a tool's files into one the profiler reads (docs/16 "Importers").

extensions.description: The file extensions it takes (".out"), any case.

magic.description: Text the file must begin with; the profiler's own readers take it otherwise.

run.description: The command, run in the workspace's root (a trusted workspace): it writes ${output} - Chrome trace JSON, pprof or an .iedtrace - from ${input}; ${pluginFolder} and ${config:<key>} expand too.

order.description: Lower = higher in the sidebar. Built-ins: chat 0, editor 10, git 20.

view.description: UI module export that renders the activity. Without one the activity is a dock host: a document well and its tool windows.

phoneSlot.description: Request a primary slot in the phone bottom nav (host decides).

documents.description: A dock host's tab kinds: tabs of these open in its document well, others in a dock host that takes them. Absent: any kind.

emptyWell.description: Commands its empty document well offers, first.

newTab.description: The command a document strip's "+" (and a double click on the strip's free end) runs, with that strip's group focused so the new tab opens there - a browser's new tab.

dockGroup.description: Tool windows of one dock and group share a tab group; another group of the dock goes beside it.

defaultSize.description: The share of the activity's width (left, right) or height (bottom) a new group for it takes; the dock's usual share when absent.

open.description: false: the default layout leaves it out; its menu item opens it.

modes.description: Its place in a layout mode's default (layoutModes), by mode id; what a mode leaves out comes from the fields above.

phoneNav.description: false: no slot in the phone's bottom nav or its More list; its activity's pane reaches it (shell.showView).

layoutMode.description: A window layout of its own while `when` holds, as VS's debugging layout (docs/15 'Window layouts').

binding.description: Server binding to call; omit when the UI module handles it.

toolbarItem.description: A UI module's view rendered in the toolbar after its commands (dropdowns, live buttons).

panel.description: A UI module's view in the full-width dock under every activity, collapsible to its header row (the terminal dock; the first loaded plugin's).

settingsPage.description: A UI module's own editor for some settings, shown in the settings window under its page in place of the generic rows for those keys (the chat plugin's Models and Model Groups).

page.description: The settings page it goes under (a settings contribution's page, as AI).

grammar.description: Path to a Monarch grammar (JSON) used until semantic tokens arrive.

taskComments.description: Comment tokens for the Task List (TODO, HACK...).

fences.description: Markdown fence names that mean this language ('cpp', 'c++'); the language's id always does.

controlKeywords.description: Keywords the grammar names one by one ('keyword.return') that read as control flow.

label.description: e.g. 'Visual Assist style'. Owner chooses among palettes in settings.

rules.description: Token selector ('type', 'type.builtin', 'function.declaration', 'controlFlow') to a theme syntax token name ('--syntax-type'). Raw colors are rejected.

priority.description: 'default' opens by default; 'option' only appears in Open With.

initializationOptionsFile.description: JSON file merged over initializationOptions (file keys win); watched; change -> didChangeConfiguration or restart.

pluginCodeOption.description: An initializationOptions key that gets the workspace's plugin code scopes: [{folders, interface, allow}] - one per c4 plugin loaded for it, as the server compiles its code (docs/26 "Editing plugin code").

settingsBindings.description: Plugin setting key to initializationOptions/didChangeConfiguration path, pushed live.

scope.description: project = one server per project of a solution (the document's owning project); ${projectName} and ${projectDir} then name it (docs/24).

launchMode.description: staged = run a cached copy and restart when the source binary changes.

purpose.description: A request IED's own code tools call for this purpose (docs/13 code_expand_macro): expandMacro takes TextDocumentPositionParams and answers {name, expansion} or the expansion as a string.

source.description: Shown in the Error List 'source' column.

discover.description: Task id or binding that lists tests (JSON).

detect.description: Glob that marks a project as using this preset (e.g. 'nuke.toml').

extends.description: A preset read first, whose variables, tasks, toolbar, debug configurations and matchers this one overrides by key (docs/26: a language's Nuke preset extends 'nuke').

problemMatcher.description: Matchers for every run step that names none, inherited steps included.

projectTemplate.description: A New Project template (docs/03 'New projects'): its steps run in the new workspace's folder, or in the open solution's to add the project there, then its files are copied into the project's folder.

language.description: The language id of the project it makes: the New Project dialog's filter and its tile (projectIcons).

tags.description: What else the dialog shows and filters by: 'Console', 'Library'.

into.description: Files in a solution's folder that let it add the project there (nuke.toml: its steps' `nuke init NAME` adds it); without them it only makes new workspaces.

files.description: A folder of the plugin copied into the new project's folder after the steps, ${name} filled in paths and text; a file already there stays.

parameters.description: JSON Schema rendered as the template's form (not read yet).

steps.description: Run first, each to its end (two minutes at most), with ${name}, ${projectDir}, ${workspaceDir}, ${config:KEY} and ${env:NAME}; the default folder is ${workspaceDir}.

projectSystem.description: A build system that owns a solution's projects (docs/03 'Managing projects'): a solution whose folder holds `detect` is its. An operation's steps change the build system's manifests in the solution's folder, then `generate` writes the IED solution and project files again; an operation it does not give is refused.

detect.description: A file in the solution's folder (nuke.toml).

generate.description: Writes the IED solution and project files from the build system's manifests: what makes a folder holding `detect` an IED solution, and what runs after every other operation.

add.description: An existing folder (${folder}) made a project, named ${name}, in ${language}, of ${kind}; an empty value leaves the choice to the build system.

remove.description: ${projectName} (in ${folder}) taken out of the build, its folder kept.

delete.description: ${projectName} taken out of the build before IED moves its folder to the trash.

move.description: After IED moved ${projectName}'s folder from ${from} to ${to} (open documents follow it): the build system's entries for it fixed.

projectSystemSteps.description: Run in the solution's folder, each to its end (two minutes at most), with ${workspaceDir}, ${projectName}, ${folder}, ${from}, ${to}, ${name}, ${language}, ${kind} (paths relative to the solution's folder, '/'), ${config:KEY} and ${env:NAME}.

toolCall.description: An AI tool (docs/26 section 8): a command it runs (`run`), a provided binding, or a C4 function of the plugin's code.

preload.description: Send its definition with every request. Off, the chat lists it by name and loads it on demand (tool_search, docs/13).

binding.description: Provided binding that implements the tool.

function.description: A function of the plugin's C4 code that implements the tool ('Rust::Tools::Metadata').

ownThread.description: For a `function` tool: each call runs on a thread of its own as the plugin's code, so a long one (a build) leaves the plugin's thread to its bindings and other calls; the function then guards the plugin's state itself (docs/26 section 8).

plan.description: For a `function` or `binding` tool: a function of the plugin's C4 code, `IED::ToolPlan <Name>(const IED::ToolCall&)`, that says what a call will do for its approval card - a summary and the change as a unified diff - or why it cannot work. Called only for a call that asks the owner, at most 5 seconds; it only reads. When it fails the card shows the call as it is (docs/26 section 8).

run.description: The command: argv, with ${args.<name>} the call's arguments (a list argument as a whole word is a word per item).

cwd.description: The folder it runs in, relative to the workspace's root.

output.description: text: the exit code and the output's tail; json: the whole output, for a tool whose output is data.

function.description: A function of the plugin's C4 code, `Core::String <Name>(const IED::Workspace& ws)`, that computes the text per workspace (empty: no section).
